title: What Interstellar Trade Protocols Is
definition: Interstellar Trade Protocols: how economies work when shipments take decades.
description:
Interstellar Trade Protocols is how economies work when shipments take decades. It sits squarely in Interstellar & Deep Space Futures, the frontier where contract law science becomes trade logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are cargo insurance-scale. Societies that master trade hulls early will shape dilation accounting practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why contract law programs worldwide now treat Interstellar Trade Protocols as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Interstellar Trade Protocols needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Real Research Today: Interstellar Trade Protocols
definition: Today's documented research behind Interstellar Trade Protocols.
description:
The road to Interstellar Trade Protocols is already being paved. The 100 Year Starship project (DARPA/NASA seeded) studies the capabilities needed for interstellar flight within a century. NASA Innovative Advanced Concepts (NIAC) funds early-stage interstellar propulsion studies, including fusion and beamed-energy concepts.

Icarus Interstellar is a nonprofit research network designing theoretical interstellar spacecraft. Together these programs form the contract law foundation that Interstellar Trade Protocols will build on — the trade logistics results, the dilation accounting methods, and the institutional memory.

title: Readiness Estimator: Interstellar Trade Protocols
definition: Estimates Interstellar Trade Protocols readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Interstellar Trade Protocols components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a trade hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Interstellar Trade Protocols Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Interstellar Trade Protocols: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Interstellar Trade Protocols — how economies work when shipments take decades.

Phase 1 — Prove (contract law): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (trade logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (dilation accounting): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (cargo insurance): trade hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and interstellar markets-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
